description: This file implements the basic functions for a TLS Connection Controller object, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and destruction, using a C-based object-oriented design pattern. It defines core object lifecycle functions and manages internal components like packet descriptors and interface structures.

classes.name: TLS_CONN_CONTROLLER_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing the TLS Connection Controller, encapsulating properties and methods related to managing TLS connections.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE TlsCcoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new TLS Connection Controller object, setting up basic properties and function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the TLS Connection Controller object, freeing allocated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls and allocates necessary sub-objects and interfaces required by the TLS controller.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the TLS controller object properties and internal state, preparing it for operation.
